message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: forging documents (falsifying financial documents) to obtain loan, then defaulting. Likely crime of "诈骗罪" (fraud) by means of falsified documents to obtain loan. Also possibly "伪造金融票据罪" or "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章罪"? But forging purchase invoices used as credit proof. Thus output: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
